title: Euplotes crassus Transfection Using Lipofectamine 2000
author: RACHELE CESARONI
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2aigace

steps.title: Collect Euplotes cells
steps.instruction: Collect 4 × 10⁴ well‑fed Euplotes crassus cells (fed on E. coli) by centrifugation at 400 rcf for 3 min.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with artificial sea water and once with 500 mM sorbitol, 0.5 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 7.0), centrifuging at 400 rcf for 3 min each wash. Resuspend the pellet in 50 μl of the same sorbitol‑Tris medium; if needed, centrifuge an additional minute to obtain the small volume.

steps.title: Prepare artificial sea water
steps.instruction: Make 1 L artificial sea water by mixing 36 g Reef Crystals, 1 mL Walne’s solution, 1 mL of 10 μg mL⁻¹ FeSO₄, 0.2 mL of 2 mg mL⁻¹ thiamine (light‑sensitive; store at 4 °C), and add distilled water up to 1 L.

steps.title: Transfer cells to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the 50 μl cell suspension into individual wells of a 96‑well plate for transfection.

steps.title: Dilute Lipofectamine 2000
steps.instruction: Dilute 2.5 μl Lipofectamine 2000 reagent in 25 μl of the sorbitol‑Tris medium (500 mM sorbitol, 0.5 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 7.0).

steps.title: Dilute plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Dilute 5 μg plasmid DNA (stock 0.5–5 μg μl⁻¹ in MilliQ H₂O) in 125 μl of the same sorbitol‑Tris medium.

steps.title: Form transfection complexes
steps.instruction: Mix 25 μl of the diluted DNA with 25 μl of the diluted Lipofectamine (1:1 ratio), pipette up and down five times (or vortex 10 s), and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Add complexes to cells
steps.instruction: Add 10 μl of the transfection mixture drop‑wise to the 50 μl cell suspension in each well, gently swirling the plate to distribute uniformly.

steps.title: Add first sea water aliquot
steps.instruction: One hour after adding complexes, add 50 μl of artificial sea water to each well.

steps.title: Add second sea water aliquot
steps.instruction: One hour later, add an additional 50 μl of artificial sea water to each well.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: One hour after the second addition, collect cells by centrifugation at 400 rcf for 3 min, wash twice with artificial sea water (400 rcf, 3 min each), and resuspend the pellet in 400 μl artificial sea water.

steps.title: Transfer to depression wells
steps.instruction: Move the resuspended cells into depression wells for subsequent incubation.

steps.title: Incubate and analyze expression
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells at 24 °C, then examine them by fluorescence microscopy to assess gene expression.
